d: As a Business Development Manager at Tarjama&, you will drive business growth by focusing on the promotion and adoption of the company’s technology-driven products and services. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, building strong relationships with clients and partners, and collaborating across teams to design tailored solutions that meet customer needs and align with our technological vision.
q: Establish and cultivate long-term relationships with clients and partners to promote business growth in technology-driven language and localization services.
Leverage a deep understanding of the company’s products and services to prepare and deliver impactful proposals, solution demonstrations, and presentations to prospective clients.
Proactively explore emerging technologies and market trends to identify opportunities for product and service expansion.
Work closely with clients to understand their technological needs and recommend solutions that leverage our tech platforms and language services.
Collaborate with the product and technology teams to refine offerings and align with client requirements.
Serve as a technology advocate, communicating the value of our innovative tools and solutions to clients and partners.
Build and manage a robust sales pipeline, ensuring timely follow-ups and accurate forecasting.
Track and analyze key performance metrics, providing regular reports and actionable insights to senior management.
Develop strategies to optimize the sales process and enhance efficiency.
Partner with internal teams, including operations, quality assurance, marketing, and technology experts, to ensure seamless delivery of solutions.
Actively contribute to the ideation and development of new technology features and enhancements to meet market demands.
Facilitate knowledge-sharing sessions to keep teams informed about product updates and market trends.
Represent the company at technology and industry events, conferences, and trade shows to promote the brand and establish new connections.
Maintain an up-to-date understanding of the competitive landscape and industry developments.
Engage in thought leadership activities, such as participating in panels, webinars, or publishing articles on technology’s role in language services.
Build and maintain trust with clients by providing consistent, high-quality service and support.
Address client inquiries and concerns promptly, ensuring satisfaction and long-term engagement.
Proactively gather client feedback to inform continuous improvement of products and services.
A bachelor’s degree in business management or any related field is preferable.
Approximately 8 years of proven enterprise sales experience gained in a high-tech, IT Consulting or Technology Services company selling to enterprise and strategic accounts.
Extensive experience of successfully selling into complex accounts with a strong negotiation and closing track record.
A good understanding of Language and Translation services and the challenges faced within the specific market sectors.
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
Strong verbal and written communications skills.
Excellent in-person and phone-based presentation skills. • Excellent level of proficiency with MS Office Project, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
Excellent command of both spoken and written English.

d: Optasia is a fully-integrated B2B2X financial technology platform covering scoring, financial decisioning, disbursement & collection. We provide a versatile AI Platform powering financial inclusion, delivering responsible financing decision-making and driving a superior business model & strong customer experience with presence in 30 Countries anchored by 7 Regional Offices.

We are looking for enthusiastic, energetic and results-driven professionals with a can-do attitude, who want to join a team of like-minded people delivering innovative solutions in an exciting environment.

As a member of the People Operations Team, you will play a key role in the effective delivery and coordination of international People Operations activities across our global entities. You will take ownership of global benefits administration, support international operations and manage a wide range of HR operational activities, while driving consistency, effective stakeholder collaboration and continuous improvement across countries.
q: 5-7+ years of progressive experience in People Ops, International HR Operations or a similar role, ideally within a multinational fast-paced environment
Demonstrated experience in benefits administration, preferably across multiple countries or legal entities
Proven ability to coordinate daily operations and provide functional guidance to junior colleagues
Strong stakeholder and vendor management capabilities, with the ability to coordinate multiple parties and follow through on outstanding matters
Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to independently assess situations, identify solutions and make informed decisions
Strong ownership and accountability, demonstrating a proactive approach to managing responsibilities and follow-through completion
High attention to detail and data accuracy, curiosity and a genuine interest in HR operational excellence

Optasia is a high-growth, AI-powered financial infrastructure platform serving over 432 million users in emerging markets across Africa and Asia. By harnessing the power of AI and real-time data we unlock financial opportunities for customers. We have been recognized as a top fintech by Forbes Middle East, culminating in a successful JSE listing in 2025.

At Optasia, our global team builds the tech, products and services which will change the game for the world's unbanked population. We empower our people by offering unique employee experiences and support individual careers by prioritizing well-being and embracing flexibility.
